notes:
Wake word ab tagda: mic hamesha khula (Android 13+), beech me koi shabd nahi chhootta aur mic ki ting nahi bajti.
'Hey Goku', 'हे गोकू', 'hello gokoo', 'ok go ku' jaise bahut tareeke pakde jaate hain.
Sunna band ho ya atak jaye to apne-aap theek ho jata hai.
Price card (₹50) ab website par sabse upar.
Build fix: androidx.core 1.16.0.
